_about: Buyers who publish a way for a new supplier to introduce himself: quick-commerce and fresh-grocery platforms, cash-and-carry and modern-trade chains, agri B2B marketplaces, hotel-group vendor portals and airline caterers. Written by hand; each URL is fetched by the registrations source to confirm it is still live, and the date of that check is recorded. A `contact` is filled only from what the page itself publishes - never assumed.

_schema.name: the buyer
_schema.url: the public supplier-onboarding or vendor-registration page
_schema.buys: what they buy that the supplier could provide
_schema.how: what the page asks a new supplier to do
_schema.contact: only if the page publishes one; null otherwise
_schema.city: where the buying office sits, where it is stated
_schema.type: quick_commerce | fresh_grocery | cash_and_carry | modern_trade | agri_b2b | hotel_group | caterer
